sentences.en: The park is private property and not open to the public.
sentences.zh: 这个公园是私有财产，不向公众开放。

sentences.en: She inherited her family's private property when they passed away.
sentences.zh: 她继承了家里的私有财产。

sentences.en: The government has been working to protect private property rights.
sentences.zh: 政府一直在努力保护私有财产权。
